Here is the full architecture slice for this feature (notify the approver when a leave request is cancelled), as I committed it. Note up front: my original record is `.gestalt/architecture/app.json`; `.gestalt/architecture/reconciled.json` is the reconciled version that folds in the data slice's `related_entity_code` decision and the operator's resolutions of the open questions. Where the two differ I give the reconciled value as operative and flag the delta, because you are reconciling against domain/data.

## 1. Module boundaries (exact names + paths)

Backend modules (reconciled set; app.json listed only the first four plus the shared-* foundations):

| Module | Path | Role in this feature |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `leave` | `src/modules/leave/` | Sole orchestrator; the ONLY module that changes. Owns `ILeaveService.cancel` (extended), `ILeaveService.listPendingDecisions` (new), private `resolveApproverRecipient(request)`, the approver-notification composition, `ILeaveRepository.findPendingDecisions` + `PgLeaveRequestRepository.findPendingDecisions`, and the `GET /leaves/pending-decisions` route in `leave.routes.ts`. `LEAVE_REQUEST_ENTITY_TYPE` unchanged; CANCEL audit entry NOT modified. |
| `notification` | `src/modules/notification/` | `INotificationService.create(input, client?)` contract unchanged; consumed by leave inside the caller's transaction. Reconciled: `Notification` model / `PgNotificationRepository` EXTENDED end-to-end for `related_entity_code` (COLUMNS, `NotificationRow`, `mapRow`, INSERT). |
| `employee` | `src/modules/employee/` | `IEmployeeService.getEmployeeById(id)` unchanged; consumed by leave to resolve the requester's direct manager. `IEmployeeRepository.findById`/`findByManagerId` unchanged. |
| `audit` | `src/modules/audit/` | `IAuditService.record(input, client?)` unchanged; CANCEL entry stays byte-identical (no new action, no new entityType, no second entry). |
| `balance` | `src/modules/balance/` | `IBalanceRepository.findByKey(..., forUpdate)` / `update` unchanged; the release joins the cancellation unit of work. |
| `validation` | `src/modules/validation/` | Existing leave-request validation — unchanged. |
| `policy` | `src/modules/policy/` | Existing leave policy / balance rules — unchanged. |
| `leave-type` | `src/modules/leave-type/` | `LeaveTypeCode` catalogue — unchanged. |
| `shared-types` | `src/shared/types/` | NO new type introduced — deliberate. The approver notification payload is composed inline in `leave` (as approve/reject/cancel already do) and `listPendingDecisions` takes no query DTO. Existing `LeaveStatus`, `LeaveTypeCode`, `EmployeeRole`, `AuditAction`, `LEAVE_REQUEST_ENTITY_TYPE` consumed unchanged. |
| `shared-db` | `src/shared/db/` | `IUnitOfWork.withTransaction` unchanged; the approver notification insert joins the existing cancellation unit of work via the threaded `PoolClient`. `pg` Pool (`connection.ts`) unchanged. |
| `shared-errors` | `src/shared/errors/` | `AppError`, `ValidationError(400)`, `UnauthorizedError(401)`, `ForbiddenError(403)`, `NotFoundError(404)`, `ConflictError(409)` — unchanged, reused. |
| `shared-auth` | `src/shared/auth/` | `registerAuth` preHandler + `PUBLIC_PATHS` unchanged; `GET /leaves/pending-decisions` is NOT added to `PUBLIC_PATHS`, so it requires a valid bearer token. |
| `app` | `src/app.ts` | Fastify composition root; registers `leaveRoutes` and `registerAuth` — unchanged. |

Web root (only touched by the optional final phase): `web-leave` (`web/src/modules/leave/`), `web-approvals` (`web/src/modules/approvals/` — gains the pending-decisions read), `web-employee`, `web-shared-types`, `web-infrastructure-api` (`web/src/infrastructure/api/` — gains the `IApiClient` method), `web-presentation-pages`, `web-presentation-guards`.

Layering (extends, does not contradict, `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`): Presentation = `leave.routes.ts` (one handler, no controller file, no SQL, no role branch); Application = `LeaveService.cancel` (extended) + `LeaveService.listPendingDecisions` (new), both declared on `ILeaveService` before implementation; Domain = `LeaveRequest`/`Notification`/shared enums, no new type; Infrastructure = `PgLeaveRequestRepository.findPendingDecisions` (the only new SQL), `PgNotificationRepository` (extended), `src/shared/db` pool + `PgUnitOfWork`.

## 2. Service interface method signatures

From app.json (original):

- `ILeaveService` — `src/modules/leave/leave.service.interface.ts`: `cancel(actor, requestId)`, `listPendingDecisions(actor)`
- `ILeaveRepository` — `src/modules/leave/leave.repository.ts`: `findPendingDecisions(approverId, client)`
- `INotificationService` — `src/modules/notification/notification.service.interface.ts`: `create(input, client)`
- `IEmployeeService` — `src/modules/employee/employee.service.interface.ts`: `getEmployeeById(id)`
- `IAuditService` — `src/modules/audit/audit.service.interface.ts`: `record(input, client)`
- `IUnitOfWork` — `src/shared/db/unit-of-work.ts`: `withTransaction(work)`

Reconciled (operative) deltas:

- `ILeaveRepository.findPendingDecisions(actorId: string, actorRole: EmployeeRole, client?: PoolClient): Promise<LeaveRequest[]>` — NEW. The signature gained `actorRole` because the queue is role-scoped (ADMIN sees all SUBMITTED; MANAGER sees direct reports'; EMPLOYEE sees none). Predicate: `status = SUBMITTED` (bound from `LeaveStatus.SUBMITTED`, never a bare string) AND `reverses_request_id IS NULL`, scoped by role. `ORDER BY start_date ASC, id ASC`. Read-only: no `forUpdate`, no transaction, returns an array (possibly empty), never null.
- `INotificationRepository.create(input, client?)` — EXISTING, EXTENDED end-to-end for `related_entity_code` (COLUMNS, `NotificationRow`, `mapRow`, INSERT). The optional `client` is forwarded so the insert joins the caller's transaction.
- `ILeaveService.listPendingDecisions(actor)` delegates to `repository.findPendingDecisions(actor.id, actor.role)`.
- Unchanged: `ILeaveRepository.create/findById/findByReversesRequestId/update/findByQuery`; `IAuditRepository.create/findById/findByEntity`; `IBalanceRepository.findByKey/update/findById/create`; `IEmployeeRepository.findById/findByManagerId/create/findByEmployeeNumber/findByEmail`.

Convention: every repository method takes an optional trailing `client?: PoolClient` defaulting to the shared pool; no repository opens `BEGIN`/`COMMIT`/`ROLLBACK` (only `PgUnitOfWork` does).

## 3. Dependency directions (rules)

`leave` remains the sole orchestrator and the only module that changes. Every edge this feature uses already exists; NO new edge is added and no cycle is introduced. No module depends back on `leave`.

Edges (reconciled map):
- `leave → notification, employee, audit, balance, validation, policy, shared-types, shared-errors, shared-db, shared-auth`
- `notification → shared-types, shared-errors, shared-db`
- `employee → shared-types, shared-errors, shared-db`
- `audit → shared-types, shared-errors, shared-db`
- `balance → policy, employee, shared-db, shared-types, shared-errors`
- `validation → shared-types, shared-errors`
- `policy → leave-type, shared-types, shared-errors, shared-db`
- `leave-type → shared-types, shared-errors, shared-db`
- `shared-auth → shared-types, shared-errors`
- `app → leave, shared-auth`
- `web-leave → web-infrastructure-api, web-shared-types`
- `web-approvals → web-leave, web-employee, web-infrastructure-api, web-shared-types`
- `web-presentation-pages → web-approvals, web-leave, web-shared-types, web-presentation-guards`

The web chain `web-presentation-pages → web-approvals → web-leave → web-infrastructure-api → web-shared-types` is untouched by the backend phases. `notification`, `employee`, `audit`, `balance`, `validation`, `policy`, `leave-type` and the `shared-*` foundations are consumed through their public entry points and are unchanged.

## 4. Recommended phases

app.json (original, 6 phases): 1) leave repository `findPendingDecisions`; 2) `LeaveService.cancel` notify approver in existing UoW; 3) `LeaveService.listPendingDecisions`; 4) `GET /leaves/pending-decisions` route; 5) tests; 6) optional web approvals queue.

Reconciled (operative, 7 phases — a migration phase was prepended once the data slice added `related_entity_code` and the two indexes):

1. **Migration** (1 file) — add nullable `notifications.related_entity_code`; add standalone `leave_requests.status` index (existing index is `(employee_id, status)`, so a status-only predicate cannot use it as a leading column — this is the first status-only access path in the codebase); add `leave_requests.approver_id` index; also add the documented-but-absent `(related_entity_type, related_entity_id)` index on `notifications` (GP-008 drift made reachable here). No service, route, or repository change.
2. **Repositories** (2 files) — `leave.repository.ts`: add `findPendingDecisions(actorId, actorRole, client?)` to `ILeaveRepository`/`PgLeaveRequestRepository` (declared inline, the leave module's convention), reusing existing `COLUMNS`/`mapRow`; predicate `status = SUBMITTED` AND `reverses_request_id IS NULL`, role-scoped, `ORDER BY start_date ASC, id ASC`, read-only. `notification.repository.ts`: extend COLUMNS/`NotificationRow`/`mapRow`/INSERT for `related_entity_code`. Unit-testable via the existing `dbPool` constructor seam.
3. **`LeaveService.cancel`** (1 file) — add private `resolveApproverRecipient(request)` (APPROVED → `request.approverId` read from the ORIGINAL row; SUBMITTED → `employeeService.getEmployeeById(request.employeeId).managerId`; DRAFT → null) and one extra `notificationService.create` call inside each of the two existing `withTransaction` callbacks, same `client` threaded. Notification carries request id + leave type in title/message, `relatedEntityType 'leave_request'`, `relatedEntityId` = ORIGINAL request id, `relatedEntityCode` = leave type code. CANCEL audit entry left byte-identical. A failed notification insert throws inside the callback and rolls back the status change and balance release.
4. **`LeaveService.listPendingDecisions`** (1 file) — `assertAuthenticated`, then delegate to `repository.findPendingDecisions(actor.id, actor.role)`. Read-only: no `withTransaction`, no client, no writes, no audit, no notification. Depends on Phase 2.
5. **`GET /leaves/pending-decisions` route** (1 file) — register inside existing `leaveRoutes(fastify)`, mirroring `GET /leaves`: `resolveActor(request)` → `leaveService.listPendingDecisions(actor)` → `reply.status(200).send(rows)`; on throw `request.log.error(error)` then `sendError(reply, error)`. No controller file, no role guard, no SQL. Not added to `PUBLIC_PATHS`. Depends on Phase 4.
6. **Tests** (2 files) — extend `tests/unit/modules/leave/leave.service.test.ts` (SUBMITTED cancel → exactly one approver notification to the requester's direct manager carrying request id + leave type; APPROVED cancel → exactly one to the ORIGINAL row's `approverId`; DRAFT → zero approver notifications; same stub `PoolClient` as the status change and CANCEL audit entry inside the single `withTransaction` callback; audit entry unchanged; a throwing notification insert rolls the cancellation back; plus `listPendingDecisions` delegation/actor-id-and-role-forwarded/empty-array-is-success) and `tests/unit/modules/leave/leave.routes.test.ts` (200 with rows, 401 UNAUTHORIZED with no actor, cancelled request absent). Depends on Phases 2–5.
7. **(optional) Web approvals queue** (2 files) — `web/src/modules/approvals/approvals.service.ts` gains a pending-decisions read (or `ApprovalsService.listPending` switches to the new endpoint) and `web/src/infrastructure/api/api-client.ts` gains the `IApiClient` method. Separable: the backend contract is complete without it. Depends on Phase 5.

## Deltas to reconcile against domain/data

- **`related_entity_code`**: app.json said "no new column is introduced by this feature" and carried the leave type only in `message`; the data slice added a nullable generic `related_entity_code` column and the reconciled record adopts it (machine-readable leave type, no join back to `leave_requests`). This is why the reconciled phase list has a migration phase that app.json did not.
- **`findPendingDecisions` signature**: app.json `(approverId, client)` → reconciled `(actorId, actorRole, client?)`, because the queue is role-scoped (ADMIN all / MANAGER direct reports / EMPLOYEE none), SUBMITTED-only, `ORDER BY start_date ASC, id ASC`, excluding `reverses_request_id IS NOT NULL`.
- **Notification count**: reconciled rule is exactly TWO notification rows for SUBMITTED/APPROVED cancellations (requester + approver) and ONE for DRAFT; the existing "exactly one `notificationService.create` call" assertions must be relaxed accordingly.
- **`approver_id` index**: app.json's phase 1 rationale said the queue is keyed on the requester's manager; the reconciled SUBMITTED-only queue does not need `approver_id` for the query, but the index is still added for recipient resolution on a cancelled APPROVED request and the APPROVED-inclusion variant.

Everything above is drawn from my committed decision record and the reconciled peer record; the domain and data slices agree with the reconciled values (domain's `PendingDecision` projection, data's `related_entity_code` column and the two new indexes).
